remarks: Charming cottage-style loft located at 236 Wire Mill Rd in Stamford, offering a unique blend of character and modern convenience. This 1-bedroom unit features an open-concept loft layout filled with natural light, creating a warm and inviting living space. The home includes an in-unit washer and dryer for added convenience, along with private trash service-making everyday living easy and hassle-free. A brand new roof has just been completed, additional cosmetic updates have been completed to ensure the home is move-in ready. Available ASAP for occupancy, this property is tucked away in a peaceful setting while still being just minutes from shopping, dining, and major commuter routes. Perfect for tenants seeking a cozy, low-maintenance rental with charm, privacy, and thoughtful updates.
